# MDL105 · `key-before-group`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

A key/value pair appears before the first [group] header.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | loading |
| Default severity | error |
| Fix | — |
| Flags | unsuppressible |
| Design references | K6, case 08 |

## Why

Every key must belong to a group such as `[mydumper]` or `[myloader]`. GLib rejects a key before the first header ("Key file does not start with a group"), and mydumper then ignores the whole file.

## Example

❌ Before:

```ini
threads=4
[mydumper]
routines
```

```text
1:1-1:10 error MDL105[key-before-group] `threads` is defined before any [group] header; move it under [mydumper] or [myloader] (GLib: Key file does not start with a group)
  = mydumper ignores this entire file: it only logs a WARNING ("Failed to load config file") and runs with its defaults, exit code 0.
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL105: warning   # or error, info, off
```

Its diagnostics mean mydumper ignores the whole file: they cannot be suppressed by comments, only by the configuration or `--ignore`.
